messages:
naomi: saw a routing panic after a customer pushed a flag with unexpected schema (string vs object).
raj: thanks, tracked to flag 'payment.plugins.meta'. We currently accept arbitrary JSON which bit us.
kevin: short term I added a defensive unwrap and fallback to empty-meta so requests don't crash. infra-bot: alert #ALRT-910 opened.
naomi: long term we should attach typed contracts to flag defs + console validation + dry-run enforcement.
anya: agree. Console UX should show a live lint and sample accept/reject for the selected tenants. Also an "auto-generate" schema button from current value.
raj: runtime: propose a schema cache per service + validation on apply and at request routing. If validation fails at runtime, route to a safe_variant and increment fallback.metric.
kevin: API endpoints needed: POST /flags/:id/schema, GET /flags/:id/schema/history, POST /flags/:id/validate-payload. Add header X-Config-Dryrun for validation-only calls.
naomi: rollout plan idea: alpha internal monitor-only (1w), beta opt-in orgs (2w), default monitor-by-default (4w), staged-enforce opt-in (8w), auto-enforce for new flags (12w).
raj: enforcement gates: require <0.1% dryrun failures across 7 days and less than 3 orgs with >1% failures.
kevin: security: schema uploads must be ACL-checked and rate-limited (default 5/min/org). infra-bot: policy logged.
anya: telemetry: add counters config.schema.dryrun.fail and config.schema.apply.reject and an audit event per schema commit.
naomi: open questions: JSON Schema v2020 vs protobuf? leaning JSON Schema for flexibility.
raj: will start a small RFC and a serde bump branch. kevin: I'll stub console linting. anya: will add telemetry PR after branch.
infra-bot: ALRT-910 resolved: defensive-fallback deployed cluster-wide.
naomi: thanks team. I'll draft the RFC with sample incompatible change and console mock screenshots.
kevin: will follow up with a minimal example in the RFC repo.
